bilingual.notes: VSBPE Rule 5440-39 Bilingual Education (revised June 2018). Add-on endorsement only, layered on a base endorsement (early childhood, elementary, middle grades, special ed, ELL, science, social studies, math, or English language arts). Knowledge Standard 1.1 requires 'measurable academic language proficiency in English and a second language including listening, speaking, reading and writing skills'; the rule does not name a specific proficiency exam. Practicum required in Bilingual/Dual Language Education at the PK-6 or 7-12 level (PK-12 authorization requires a practicum at both levels). Approved-program pathway is the standard route (endorsement 39 is not on the Transcript Review list at Rule 5230).

eld.notes: VSBPE Rule 5440-40 English Language Multilingual Learner (revised August 2015, May 2022; abbreviated 'ELLML'). Five competency standards: Knowledge About Language; Multilingual Learners in the Sociocultural Context; Planning and Implementing Instruction; Assessment and Evaluation; Professionalism and Leadership. Approved Educator preparation program is the standard pathway (endorsement 40 is not on the Transcript Review list). Practicum required at PK-8 or 5-12 (PK-12 authorization requires both). Required test: Praxis II ESOL (test code 5362) per Rule 5246. Rule 5440-40 §1.2 explicitly aligns to WIDA English Language Development Standards.

sei.notes: Vermont has no general SEI/sheltered-instruction mandate for all teachers. EL instruction is delivered by educators holding endorsement 40 (ELLML); the Core Teaching Standards (5235) reference linguistic diversity but do not require EL-specific competency from every license holder.

history.title: Rule 5440-39 revision (Bilingual endorsement)
history.description: The Vermont Standards Board for Professional Educators revised Rule 5440-39, clarifying the Bilingual endorsement as an add-on credential and aligning its standards with current bilingual-instruction practice.

history.title: EPAA 29(100) document analysis (Leider, Colombo & Nerlino, 2021)
history.description: Leider, Colombo & Nerlino published in Education Policy Analysis Archives 29(100) a comprehensive document analysis of every state and DC's bilingual, ELD/ESL, and SEI teacher-credentialing requirements, professional teaching standards mentions, and EL-percentage figures, based on primary SEA sources collected October–December 2019. The 2019 coding of Vermont's EL-credentialing landscape is preserved as a temporally-anchored research baseline against which the catalog's later verifications are framed.

history.title: Vermont Seal of Biliteracy adoption
history.description: Vermont established the State Seal of Biliteracy, recognizing high-school graduates demonstrating proficiency in English and one or more additional languages. The seal is administered by the Agency of Education in coordination with the Vermont State Seal of Biliteracy Council.

history.title: Rule 5440-40 revision: English Language Multilingual Learner endorsement
history.description: Rule 5440-40 was revised to rename and restructure Vermont's ELD endorsement as the English Language Multilingual Learner (ELLML) endorsement, aligning naming conventions with current asset-based framing.
